RagShortTexts: Vandal war requires crossings, passes and protected grain.

Variants.Content: Vandal war requires crossings, passes and grain routes. Concentration reduces warnings elsewhere, and mounted and foot followers both depend on settlement supplies.

Vandal war requires crossings, passes and protected grain. These forces remain limited by food, rest and loads; vanguard speed does not represent the whole column. Concentrating forces reduces warnings elsewhere.

Concentrating forces reduces warnings elsewhere. Usable strength includes supply, home guards and exits; concentration reduces another reserve. Vandal war requires crossings, passes and protected grain.
Vandal war requires crossings, passes and protected grain. Fighters come from households; prolonged loss of labor or animals weakens the next levy. Concentrating forces reduces warnings elsewhere.
Concentrating forces reduces warnings elsewhere. Repair, carrying and care also use people, while daily supply continues after troops pass. Vandal war requires crossings, passes and protected grain.
